title: What If The Moon Disappeared Tonight?

scenes.narration: Tonight, the moon disappears. No explosion. It's just gone.

scenes.narration: The first thing you'd notice: darkness. Real darkness. Every full moon night, gone forever.

scenes.narration: The tides shrink to about a third. Beaches change. Fishing towns wake up to boats on dry mud.

scenes.narration: Animals that hunt and breed by moonlight lose their clock. Coral reefs stop spawning together.
